summary: Backend testing for iteration 28: plans cache coherency fix (await plans_cache.ainvalidate on create/update/delete). 18/18 backend tests passed. Cache invalidation is now atomic — superadmin edits are immediately visible to admin GET /api/plans and GET /api/plans/usage/{company_id} without waiting for 5-min TTL. All validation cases (404 non-existent, 400 malformed id, 403 admin forbidden), lifecycle (create+immediate GET, delete+immediate GET, delete-in-use blocked), regression (assign plan, Stripe checkout with origin_url, /patients, /sales, /support-tickets, /prescriptions/*) verified.
critical_code_review_comments: cache.py still ships legacy sync `invalidate()` that fires-and-forgets a task on Redis; consider removing or renaming to `_invalidate_unsafe` to prevent regressions where other routes accidentally use it (grep confirms plans.py no longer uses it, but companies_cache/inventory_cache paths should be audited similarly).

routes/plans.py:38 update_plan/{plan_id} — the try/except around ObjectId also wraps the DB call; if find_one raises for reasons other than bad id it will surface as 400 'plan_id invalido'. Wrap only ObjectId(plan_id) conversion in try/except (same pattern already used in delete_plan lines 58-61).
seed_data_creation: Test creates and deletes an ephemeral 'TEST_Plan_<rand>' plan; also mutates existing plan prices temporarily but restores them at end of each test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_plans_cache.py at /app/backend/tests uses requests.Session with httpOnly cookies (no bearer token in login body). Login uses POST /api/auth/login with email/password JSON, session cookies persist. BASE_URL falls back to reading /app/frontend/.env when REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var is not set in shell. billing/checkout requires 'origin_url' in body (Pydantic 422 otherwise).
